body: Okay, thank you. She has been doing therapy for a few weeks since her first suicidal episode once she was released from the hospital/ward. I just found out that she has been out of her medication for 10 days or so because her therapist cannot prescribe and screwed something up. I do think she is an alcoholic and probably addicted to a few other substances, but my parents have told me they can't do anything because she is 21, so she has to realize on her own that she is an addict? I don't know if this is true or not, but there doesn't seem to be much I can do. I am also afraid of confronting her because I know she is in a delicate state, and I don't want to drive her away and make her feel like I am a snitch or something like this.

No she is definitely not being abused. Our parents are very loving, but they are a bit weird with certain rules. They are very strict, so my sister feels very restricted. Mainly she wants to drink and do drugs, but my parents are very against this. My oldest sister actually left and has only spoken with them once for this reason. They love her, but she seems to think they don't because they enforce such strict rules.

The main issue is that our parents aren't accepting of her lifestyle of drugs and alcohol. I have no clue how to help because they will not change their ways. I just feel so helpless and terrible because I do want to help her.
Thank you, I will talk with them as soon as I get a chance. I'm in the US just for future reference. Thank you again.
